item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - Coco Jones - AFROPUNK Brasil 2025
item.description:
Coco Jones will perform at AFROPUNK Brasil 2025 this Saturday, November 8, in Salvador, Bahia. According to the event, all concerts happening on Saturday will only be streamed live on YouTube and they won’t be available afterward: https://www.youtube.com/c/afropunk. I would record it, but I’ll be at the festival. Can anyone record it?

Tems’ set, along with all other concerts happening on Sunday, will also be streamed live on YouTube and on Multishow.
